title: Grok Build conversations
description: Grok Build conversations as transcripts: pick a conversation, read its talks (prompt, response and the steps the agent took), follow its flow, and inspect any step: its input, output and the file change it made. Prompt and response text, commands, file paths, tool input and output fill only when the agents log them (OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS, OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS, OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT); otherwise lengths, tool names and outcomes show.

panels.title: Conversations
panels.description: One row per Grok Build conversation (session) with events in the time range, newest first. Click a Conversation id to open it: that sets Conversation, clears Talk and Step, and narrows the time range to the conversation; the panels below then fill. Title = the first prompt in the range, only when the agent logs prompt text (OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS); empty otherwise. Started / Last activity = first and last event in the range; Span = the time between them. Talks = prompts; Turns = finished turns; Model calls = API responses; Subagents launched = subagent start events (the task tool); Terminal runs = shell tool results; Files touched = distinct file paths, "-" unless tool details are on; Failed tools = tool results whose outcome is not success. Tokens = input + output (Grok counts cache reads inside input and reasoning inside output); Cache read % = cache read / input; Cost = what Grok reports ("-" for headless runs, which send none). Everything comes from Loki events. A subagent runs as its own conversation, but Grok does not send its parent, so child conversations are listed like any other and are not marked. (none) = data without nexus headers. Honours VM, Persona and User; ignores Conversation, Talk and Step so you can switch. Loki returns at most 1000 series per query, so a range with more conversations errors: narrow the time range.

targets.expression:
SELECT
  SUBSTRING(ids.session_id, 1, 8) AS `Conversation`,
  COALESCE(t.title, '') AS `Title`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(st.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Started`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(en.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Last activity`,
  (en.__value__ - st.__value__) / 1000 AS `Span`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.host_name, ''), '(none)') AS `VM`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.persona, ''), '(none)') AS `Persona`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.user_email, ''), '(none)') AS `User`,
  COALESCE(n.talks, 0) AS `Talks`,
  COALESCE(n.turns, 0) AS `Turns`,
  COALESCE(n.calls, 0) AS `Model calls`,
  COALESCE(n.subs, 0) AS `Subagents launched`,
  COALESCE(n.term, 0) AS `Terminal runs`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.det, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(n.files, 0) END AS `Files touched`,
  COALESCE(n.in_t, 0) + COALESCE(n.out_t, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.in_t, 0) > 0 THEN 100 * COALESCE(n.cr, 0) / n.in_t END AS `Cache read %`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.cost, 0) > 0 THEN n.cost / 1000000 END AS `Cost`,
  COALESCE(n.failed, 0) AS `Failed tools`,
  CAST(FLOOR(st.__value__) - 60000 AS SIGNED) AS `start_ms`,
  CAST(FLOOR(en.__value__) + 60000 AS SIGNED) AS `end_ms`,
  ids.session_id AS `session_id`
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM I UNION SELECT session_id FROM LS) ids
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, MAX(host_name) AS host_name, MAX(persona) AS persona, MAX(user_email) AS user_email
           FROM I GROUP BY session_id) a ON a.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LS st ON st.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LE en ON en.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, MAX(title) AS title FROM T WHERE session_id <> '-' GROUP BY session_id) t ON t.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'talks' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS talks, SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'turns' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS turns, SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'calls' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'subs' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS subs,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'term' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS term, SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'failed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'det' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS det, SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'files' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS files,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'in' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS in_t,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'out' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS out_t,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'cr' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS cr, SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'cost' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS cost
           FROM N GROUP BY session_id) n ON n.session_id = ids.session_id
WHERE ids.session_id <> '-'
ORDER BY `Started` DESC

value.title: Open this conversation (sets Conversation and narrows the time range to it)

panels.title: Talks
panels.description: The selected conversation, one row per talk (a prompt and the turn that answered it), oldest first. Prompt = the prompt text in a code block when the agent logs prompts (OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS), else "not logged" and its length. Response = the turn's reply text when responses are logged (OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES, which follows OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS when unset), else its length; long texts show their first 4000 characters. What the agent did = the turn's tool calls (count, turn outcome, turn duration); open it for the steps in order: outcome, tool, duration and the command, file or parameter preview, which need tool details (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS) or tool content (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT); without them only the tool names show. Model calls, Tokens (input + output) and Cost are summed over the turn's API responses. Click a Talk id to focus Flow, Steps and Changes on it. Empty until a conversation is picked. Honours VM, Persona, User and Conversation; ignores Talk so you can switch.

targets.expr: {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_call_count!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id="$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user"

{service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id="$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | drop tool_input, tool_output, error_message | label_format step_item=`{{ $s := "other" }}{{ if eq .outcome "success" }}{{ $s = "ok" }}{{ else if eq .outcome "error" }}{{ $s = "error" }}{{ else if or (eq .outcome "permission_rejected") (eq .outcome "hook_denied") }}{{ $s = "denied" }}{{ else if or (eq .outcome "permission_cancelled") (eq .outcome "cancelled") }}{{ $s = "cancelled" }}{{ else if eq .outcome "invalid_tool" }}{{ $s = "invalid" }}{{ else if eq .outcome "followup" }}{{ $s = "followup" }}{{ end }}{{ $d := "" }}{{ if .duration_ms }}{{ if lt (int .duration_ms) 1000 }}{{ $d = printf "%s ms" .duration_ms }}{{ else if lt (int .duration_ms) 60000 }}{{ $d = printf "%.1f s" (divf .duration_ms 1000) }}{{ else }}{{ $d = printf "%.1f min" (divf .duration_ms 60000) }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ $x := .full_command }}{{ if not $x }}{{ $x = .file_path }}{{ end }}{{ if not $x }}{{ $x = .tool_parameters }}{{ end }}{{ printf "%-9s %-24s %-9s " $s (regexReplaceAll "(?s)^(.{0,28}).*" .tool_name "${1}") $d }}{{ (regexReplaceAll "(?s)^(.{0,90}).*" (Replace (Replace $x "\r" "" -1) "\n" " ⏎ " -1) "${1}") }}`

targets.expression:
SELECT q.`Time`, q.`Turn`, q.`Prompt`, q.`Response`, q.`What the agent did`, q.`Model calls`, q.`Tokens`, q.`Cost`, q.`Talk`, q.`prompt_id`, q.`session_id`
FROM (
SELECT NULL AS `Time`, NULL AS `Turn`, 'Pick a conversation: click its id in Conversations (or widen the time range).' AS `Prompt`, '' AS `Response`, '' AS `What the agent did`, NULL AS `Model calls`,
       NULL AS `Tokens`, NULL AS `Cost`, '' AS `Talk`, '' AS `prompt_id`, '' AS `session_id`, 0 AS o
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM P) c WHERE c.n = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
  p.Time AS `Time`,
  CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.turn_number')) AS SIGNED) AS `Turn`,
  CASE WHEN LEFT(p.Line, 1) IN ('~', '*') THEN p.Line ELSE '*could not render*' END AS `Prompt`,
  COALESCE(a.md, '*no response yet*') AS `Response`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.tool_call_count, s.n, 0) = 0 THEN CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(e.tool_call_count, s.n, 0) AS CHAR), CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.tool_call_count, s.n, 0) = 1 THEN ' tool call' ELSE ' tool calls' END, ' · ', CASE WHEN e.outcome IS NULL THEN 'running' ELSE (CASE e.outcome WHEN 'completed' THEN 'completed' WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' WHEN 'error' THEN 'error' ELSE 'other' END) END, CASE WHEN e.duration_ms IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' · ', (CASE WHEN e.duration_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.duration_ms < 1000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(e.duration_ms AS CHAR), ' ms') WHEN e.duration_ms < 60000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(e.duration_ms / 1000, 1) AS CHAR), ' s') ELSE CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(e.duration_ms / 60000, 1) AS CHAR), ' min') END)) END) WHEN s.n IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(e.tool_call_count, s.n, 0) AS CHAR), CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.tool_call_count, s.n, 0) = 1 THEN ' tool call' ELSE ' tool calls' END, ' · ', CASE WHEN e.outcome IS NULL THEN 'running' ELSE (CASE e.outcome WHEN 'completed' THEN 'completed' WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' WHEN 'error' THEN 'error' ELSE 'other' END) END, CASE WHEN e.duration_ms IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' · ', (CASE WHEN e.duration_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.duration_ms < 1000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(e.duration_ms AS CHAR), ' ms') WHEN e.duration_ms < 60000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(e.duration_ms / 1000, 1) AS CHAR), ' s') ELSE CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(e.duration_ms / 60000, 1) AS CHAR), ' min') END)) END), ' · tool results not in the time range') ELSE CONCAT('<details><summary>', CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(e.tool_call_count, s.n, 0) AS CHAR), CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.tool_call_count, s.n, 0) = 1 THEN ' tool call' ELSE ' tool calls' END, ' · ', CASE WHEN e.outcome IS NULL THEN 'running' ELSE (CASE e.outcome WHEN 'completed' THEN 'completed' WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' WHEN 'error' THEN 'error' ELSE 'other' END) END, CASE WHEN e.duration_ms IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' · ', (CASE WHEN e.duration_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.duration_ms < 1000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(e.duration_ms AS CHAR), ' ms') WHEN e.duration_ms < 60000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(e.duration_ms / 1000, 1) AS CHAR), ' s') ELSE CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(e.duration_ms / 60000, 1) AS CHAR), ' min') END)) END), '</summary>\n\n', CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~text\n', REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(s.steps, CASE WHEN s.n > s.shown THEN CONCAT('… ', CAST(s.n - s.shown AS CHAR), ' more: see Steps') ELSE '' END), '\r', ''), '~~', '~​~'), '\n~~~~~~~~~~'), '\n\n</details>') END AS `What the agent did`,
  COALESCE(k.calls, 0) AS `Model calls`,
  COALESCE(k.in_t, 0) + COALESCE(k.out_t, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(k.cost, 0) > 0 THEN k.cost / 1000000 END AS `Cost`,
  SUBSTRING(COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.prompt_id')), ''), 1, 8) AS `Talk`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.prompt_id')), '') AS `prompt_id`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.session_id')), '') AS `session_id`,
  CAST(p.tsNs AS SIGNED) AS o
FROM P p
LEFT JOIN (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a0.labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, MAX(CASE WHEN LEFT(a0.Line, 1) IN ('~', '*') THEN a0.Line ELSE '*could not render*' END) AS md
           FROM A a0 GROUP BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a0.labels, '$.prompt_id'))) a ON a.prompt_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.prompt_id'))
LEFT JOIN (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e0.labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, MAX(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e0.labels, '$.outcome'))) AS outcome,
                  MAX(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e0.labels, '$.tool_call_count')) AS SIGNED)) AS tool_call_count,
                  MAX(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e0.labels, '$.duration_ms')) AS SIGNED)) AS duration_ms
           FROM E e0 GROUP BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e0.labels, '$.prompt_id'))) e ON e.prompt_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.prompt_id'))
LEFT JOIN (SELECT prompt_id,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'calls' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS calls,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'in' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS in_t,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'out' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS out_t,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'cost' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS cost
           FROM K GROUP BY prompt_id) k ON k.prompt_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.prompt_id'))
LEFT JOIN (SELECT z.prompt_id, SUM(z.n) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN z.b < 24 THEN z.n ELSE 0 END) AS shown, CONCAT(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 0 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 1 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 2 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 3 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 4 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 5 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 6 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 7 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 8 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 9 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 10 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 11 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 12 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 13 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 14 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 15 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 16 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 17 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 18 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 19 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 20 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 21 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 22 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), ''), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN z.b = 23 THEN CONCAT(z.txt, '\n') END), '')) AS steps FROM (SELECT y.prompt_id, y.b, COUNT(*) AS n, GROUP_CONCAT(y.item ORDER BY y.ord SEPARATOR '\n') AS txt FROM (SELECT x.prompt_id, x.item, x.ord, FLOOR(SUM(LENGTH(x.item) + 1) OVER (PARTITION BY x.prompt_id ORDER BY x.ord) / 500) AS b FROM (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, CAST(r.tsNs AS SIGNED) AS ord, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.step_item')), '') AS item FROM R r) x) y GROUP BY y.prompt_id, y.b) z GROUP BY z.prompt_id) s ON s.prompt_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.labels, '$.prompt_id'))
) q
ORDER BY q.o

value.title: Focus this talk (sets Talk: Flow, Steps and Changes show only it; set Talk back to .* to clear)

panels.title: Flow
panels.description: What the selected conversation did over time, one lane per kind of event (hover for the event count in the bucket): Prompts = a prompt came in; Model calls = a model call finished; Tool: <name> = results of that tool; Failed tools = tool results whose outcome is not success; Subagents = a subagent was launched. Buckets are $__auto wide (opening a conversation narrows the time range to it, so buckets are short); a box means at least one event in that bucket, not how long the work took. Lanes with no event are not drawn. Empty until a conversation is picked. Honours VM, Persona, User, Conversation and Talk.

panels.title: Steps
panels.description: Every tool call of the selected conversation (and Talk, if set), in order (# = position in this list). Click a Tool to inspect that step below. Command = the full command (tool content: OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT), else the command in the parameter preview (tool details: OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS); File = the file path (tool details), else the path in the preview; Parameters = the preview of the call arguments (tool details; Grok cuts it at 4 KB and shortens long strings, so it may not be valid JSON). With both off only Tool, Outcome and Duration fill. Decision = the matching permission decision (allow / deny / ask). Grok scrubs secrets and home paths before sending, and the collector masks common secret shapes. Hover a long cell and click the eye icon for the full value. Shows the newest 5000 tool calls. Empty until a conversation is picked. Honours VM, Persona, User, Conversation and Talk.

targets.expr: {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | drop tool_input, tool_output, error_message

{service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | decision!="" | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | drop tool_input, tool_output, error_message

targets.expression:
SELECT q.`Time`, q.`#`, q.`Turn`, q.`Tool`, q.`Command`, q.`File`, q.`Outcome`, q.`Duration`, q.`Decision`, q.`Parameters`, q.`Talk`,
       q.`tool_use_id`, q.`prompt_id`, q.`session_id`
FROM (
SELECT NULL AS `Time`, NULL AS `#`, NULL AS `Turn`, 'Pick a conversation: click its id in Conversations (or widen the time range).' AS `Tool`, '' AS `Command`, '' AS `File`, '' AS `Outcome`, NULL AS `Duration`,
       '' AS `Decision`, '' AS `Parameters`, '' AS `Talk`, '' AS `tool_use_id`, '' AS `prompt_id`, '' AS `session_id`, 0 AS o
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM R) c WHERE c.n = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
  r.Time AS `Time`,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(r.tsNs AS SIGNED)) AS `#`,
  CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.turn_number')) AS SIGNED) AS `Turn`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_name')), '') AS `Tool`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.full_command')), ''), NULLIF(d.full_command, ''), (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters)) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters), '$.command')) END), '') AS `Command`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.file_path')), ''), (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters)) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters), '$.file_path')) END), (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters)) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters), '$.filePath')) END), (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters)) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters), '$.path')) END), '') AS `File`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.outcome')), '') AS `Outcome`,
  CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.duration_ms')) AS SIGNED) AS `Duration`,
  COALESCE(d.decision, '') AS `Decision`,
  COALESCE(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), d.tool_parameters), '') AS `Parameters`,
  SUBSTRING(COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.prompt_id')), ''), 1, 8) AS `Talk`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_use_id')), '') AS `tool_use_id`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.prompt_id')), '') AS `prompt_id`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.session_id')), '') AS `session_id`,
  CAST(r.tsNs AS SIGNED) AS o
FROM R r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd.tool_use_id, MAX(dd.decision) AS decision, MAX(dd.tool_parameters) AS tool_parameters, MAX(dd.full_command) AS full_command
           FROM (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.tool_use_id')) AS tool_use_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.decision')) AS decision,
                        JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.tool_parameters')) AS tool_parameters, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.full_command')) AS full_command FROM D) dd
           GROUP BY dd.tool_use_id) d ON d.tool_use_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_use_id'))
) q
ORDER BY q.o

panels.title: Step details
panels.description: The fields of the selected step: its tool result and its permission decision, one per row (empty fields are left out). File, Parameters, MCP names and verbatim tool names need tool details (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS); Command needs tool content (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT). Shows "pick a step" until a Tool is clicked in Steps. Honours Conversation and Step.

targets.expression:
SELECT f.`Field`, COALESCE(f.`Detail`, '') AS `Detail`
FROM (
SELECT -1 AS o, 'Step' AS `Field`, 'Pick a step: click a Tool in Steps.' AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM R) c1, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM D) c2 WHERE c1.n + c2.n = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS o, 'Tool' AS `Field`, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_name')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_name'))) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS o, 'Time (UTC)' AS `Field`, CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(CAST(COALESCE(r.tsNs, d.tsNs) AS SIGNED) / 1000000000)) AS CHAR) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS o, 'Talk' AS `Field`, SUBSTRING(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.prompt_id')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.prompt_id'))), 1, 8) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS o, 'Turn' AS `Field`, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.turn_number')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.turn_number'))) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 AS o, 'Outcome' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.outcome')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 5 AS o, 'Success' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.success')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 6 AS o, 'Duration' AS `Field`, CONCAT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.duration_ms')), ' ms') AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 7 AS o, 'File' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.file_path')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 8 AS o, 'File type' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.file_extension')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 9 AS o, 'Command' AS `Field`, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.full_command')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.full_command'))) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 10 AS o, 'Parameters' AS `Field`, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_parameters')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_parameters'))) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 11 AS o, 'MCP server' AS `Field`, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.mcp_server_name')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.mcp_server_name'))) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 12 AS o, 'MCP tool' AS `Field`, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.mcp_tool_name')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.mcp_tool_name'))) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 13 AS o, 'Hook rewrote' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.hook_rewrote')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 14 AS o, 'Model' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.model')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 15 AS o, 'Decision' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.decision')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 16 AS o, 'Access' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.access_kind')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 17 AS o, 'Permission mode' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.permission_mode')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 18 AS o, 'Decision source' AS `Field`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.source')) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 19 AS o, 'Call id' AS `Field`, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_use_id')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_use_id'))) AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 20 AS o, 'Result' AS `Field`, CASE WHEN r.labels IS NULL THEN 'no tool-result event in the time range (still running, or outside the range)' END AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 21 AS o, 'Decision event' AS `Field`, CASE WHEN d.labels IS NULL THEN 'none in the time range' END AS `Detail` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
) f
WHERE f.`Detail` IS NOT NULL AND f.`Detail` <> ''
ORDER BY f.o

panels.title: Step evidence
panels.description: What the selected step got and returned: Input = the call arguments as JSON, Command = the full shell command, Output = what the tool returned (for shell commands "exit: <code>" then the output), Error = the failure message of a failed step, Subagent = the subagent id a task call reports. All need tool content (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT); Grok caps each at 60 KB (the error message at 4 KB) and scrubs secrets and home paths, and the collector masks common secret shapes. Shows "pick a step" until a Tool is clicked in Steps. Honours Conversation and Step.

targets.expr: {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id="$session" | tool_use_id!="" | tool_use_id="$tool"
{service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | decision!="" | session_id="$session" | tool_use_id!="" | tool_use_id="$tool" | drop tool_output

targets.expression:
SELECT f.`Part`, COALESCE(f.`Content`, '') AS `Content`
FROM (
SELECT -1 AS o, 'Step' AS `Part`, 'Pick a step: click a Tool in Steps.' AS `Content` FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM R) c1, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM D) c2 WHERE c1.n + c2.n = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS o, 'Input' AS `Part`, CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_input')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_input'))) IS NULL THEN '*not logged: needs tool content*' WHEN JSON_VALID(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_input')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_input')))) THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~json\n', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_PRETTY(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_input')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_input')))), '\\u003c', '<'), '\\u003e', '>'), '\\u0026', '&'), '\r', ''), '~~', '~​~'), '\n~~~~~~~~~~') ELSE CONCAT('*cut at 60 KB by Grok (not valid JSON):*\n\n', CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~text\n', REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_input')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_input'))), '\r', ''), '~~', '~​~'), '\n~~~~~~~~~~')) END AS `Content` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS o, 'Command' AS `Part`, CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.full_command')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.full_command'))) IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~sh\n', REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.full_command')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.full_command'))), '\r', ''), '~~', '~​~'), '\n~~~~~~~~~~') END AS `Content` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS o, 'Output' AS `Part`, CASE WHEN r.labels IS NULL THEN '*no tool result yet*' WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_output')) IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~text\n', REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_output')), '\r', ''), '~~', '~​~'), '\n~~~~~~~~~~') WHEN (COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_input')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.tool_input'))) IS NOT NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_output')) IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.full_command')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.labels, '$.full_command'))) IS NOT NULL) THEN '*no output*' ELSE '*not logged: needs tool content*' END AS `Content` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS o, 'Error' AS `Part`, CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.error_message')) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.outcome')), '') <> 'success' THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~text\n', REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.error_message')), '\r', ''), '~~', '~​~'), '\n~~~~~~~~~~') END AS `Content` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 AS o, 'Subagent' AS `Part`, CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_output')) LIKE '%subagent_id:%' THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~text\n', REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_output')), 'subagent_id: [^[:space:]]+'), '\r', ''), '~~', '~​~'), '\n~~~~~~~~~~') END AS `Content` FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
) f
WHERE f.`Content` IS NOT NULL AND f.`Content` <> ''
ORDER BY f.o

panels.title: Step change
panels.description: The file change the selected step made, if it is a file-editing tool (search_replace, write, edit, hashline_edit, apply_patch, edit_notebook, delete_file). It is rebuilt from the tool input, not a patch reported by Grok: search_replace / edit show the replaced text as - lines and the new text as + lines (--- /dev/null = a new file); write shows the whole content as + lines; apply_patch shows the patch as sent; other edit tools show their input. A step that did not succeed was not applied. Needs tool content (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT); the file path alone needs tool details. Grok caps the input at 60 KB. Shows "pick a step" until a Tool is clicked in Steps.

targets.expression:
SELECT f.`Change`
FROM (
SELECT -1 AS o, 'Pick a step: click a Tool in Steps.' AS `Change` FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM R) c1, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM D) c2 WHERE c1.n + c2.n = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 0, CASE WHEN LEFT(COALESCE(r.Line, d.Line), 1) = '*' THEN COALESCE(r.Line, d.Line) ELSE '*Could not render this change.*' END FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs, Line FROM R LIMIT 1) r ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT labels, tsNs, Line FROM D LIMIT 1) d ON 1 = 1
WHERE r.labels IS NOT NULL OR d.labels IS NOT NULL
) f
ORDER BY f.o

panels.title: Changes
panels.description: Every file edit of the selected conversation (and Talk, if set), newest first: calls of search_replace, write, edit, hashline_edit, apply_patch, edit_notebook, delete_file, with the change rebuilt from the tool input (not a patch reported by Grok; see Step change). File and Tool need tool details (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS) for the path and for edit / write / apply_patch / hashline_edit, which Grok otherwise reports as custom_tool and which are then missing here; the change itself needs tool content (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT). Outcome other than success = not applied. Click a Tool to inspect that step. Shows the newest 200 edits. Honours VM, Persona, User, Conversation and Talk.

targets.expression:
SELECT q.`Time`, q.`Tool`, q.`File`, q.`Outcome`, q.`Change`, q.`tool_use_id`, q.`session_id`
FROM (
SELECT NULL AS `Time`, '' AS `Tool`, '' AS `File`, '' AS `Outcome`,
       'No file edits: pick a conversation in Conversations, or this conversation (or talk) edited no files in the time range.' AS `Change`,
       '' AS `tool_use_id`, '' AS `session_id`, 0 AS o
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM R) c WHERE c.n = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT r.Time AS `Time`, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_name')), '') AS `Tool`, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.chg_file')), '') AS `File`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.outcome')), '') AS `Outcome`, CASE WHEN LEFT(r.Line, 1) = '*' THEN r.Line ELSE '*Could not render this change.*' END AS `Change`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_use_id')), '') AS `tool_use_id`, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.session_id')), '') AS `session_id`, CAST(r.tsNs AS SIGNED) AS o
FROM R r
) q
ORDER BY q.o DESC
